  <!-- Status bar -->

  <!-- Song context -->
  <text x="22" y="105" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFFB2">BLINDING LIGHTS</text>
  <text x="22" y="125" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">The Weeknd</text>
  <rect x="324" y="96" width="42" height="19" rx="3" fill="#B3B3B3"/>
  <text x="345" y="109" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="7.5" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">EXPLICIT</text>

  <!-- Scrollable lyrics -->
  <text x="22" y="165" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF33">Yeah, I've been tryna call</text>
  <text x="22" y="202" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF99">I've been on my own for long enough</text>
  <text x="22" y="239" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFFB2">Maybe you can show me how to love, maybe</text>
  <text x="22" y="276" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFFB2">I'm going through withdrawals</text>
  <rect x="14" y="294" width="362" height="48" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity=".12"/>
  <text x="22" y="325" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">You don't even have to do too much</text>
  <text x="22" y="362" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF99">You can turn me on with just a touch, baby</text>
  <text x="22" y="399" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFFB2">I look around and Sin City's cold and empty</text>
  <text x="22" y="436" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFFB2">No one's around to judge me</text>
  <text x="22" y="473" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFFB2">I can't see clearly when you're gone</text>
  <text x="22" y="510" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF99">I said, ooh, I'm blinded by the lights</text>
  <text x="22" y="547" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF33">No, I can't sleep until I feel your touch</text>
  <text x="22" y="584" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF33">I said, ooh, I'm drowning in the night</text>
  <text x="22" y="621" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF33">Oh, when I'm like this, you're the one I trust</text>

  <!-- Bottom now playing -->
  <rect x="0" y="639" width="390" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
  <rect x="14" y="650" width="48" height="48" fill="url(#art)"/>

  <text x="75" y="669" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">Blinding Lights</text>
  <text x="75" y="687" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#FFFFFFB2">The Weeknd</text>

  <polyline points="318,674 322,678 329,670" fill="none" stroke="#1ED760" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="360" cy="674" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polygon points="357,668 357,680 365,674" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Playback strip -->
  <line x1="20" y1="713" x2="370" y2="713" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="713" x2="214" y2="713" stroke="#1ED760" stroke-width="3"/>

    <text x="207" y="794" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="8" font-weight="bold" fill="#1ED760">Your Library</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="304" cy="762" r="5" fill="#FFFFFFB2"/>
    <ellipse cx="304" cy="775" rx="11" ry="6" fill="#FFFFFFB2"/>
    <text x="304" y="794" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial" font-size="8" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFFB2">Profile</text>

</svg>
